name: Micronesia

flag.description: A light blue field with four white five-pointed stars arranged in a diamond, like the points of a compass, in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The blue represents the Pacific Ocean and the four stars the four states of Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei and Yap.

hook: Four white stars in a diamond, one per state, on light blue; Somalia's light-blue flag has just one big white star.
trivia: The flag is based on that of the former UN Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands, which had six stars for its districts.
Yap is famous for rai stones, huge carved limestone discs traditionally used as money.
The stone city of Nan Madol on Pohnpei, built on artificial islets in a lagoon, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
